did: The worker changed no code; the pinned check already passes.
decided: The all tests check already runs on the owner's pushes, so nothing needed building.
open: The issue card shows the GitHub checks as failed; the reviewer cannot see why.

handback.summary: Nothing to build: the owner's pushes already run all tests, and the check catches any rule skipping them.

behaviors.why: One push by the owner, one result: all tests run.

tests.why: Fails when a rule skips the owner by name, by bot type, or skips everyone.
